title: Settings
subtitle: Configure your AutoGram application.
api_config_hint: Get API ID & API Hash from my.telegram.org. On desktop, credentials are stored encrypted in the local keychain. Do not share your hash with anyone.
language_desc: Choose your preferred display language (Indonesian / English).
credentials_saved: Credentials successfully saved in Rust Keychain!
cache_management_desc: The app stores temporary data locally (thumbnails, preview data, folder/sidebar history, and transient logs) to speed up navigation. Clear cache if you want to free up disk space or reload fresh data from Telegram.
auto_prune_desc: Automatically prunes old cache periodically when exceeding limit (protects active files & transfers).
db_clear_desc: Wipes all uploaded file history, resume state, audit logs, and local scan cache. Use this if you want Transfer Manager to re-scan fresh via Telegram API to detect missing/deleted files at destination.
perf_subtitle: Configure acceleration levels for downloading, thumbnail loading, and card list rendering smoothness.
perf_tier_low_desc: Saves RAM & CPU usage. Small thumbnail batching (20 items per request).
perf_tier_mid_desc: Ideal balance of MTProto transfer speed & visual smoothness (48 batch).
perf_tier_high_desc: Maximum throughput for fast devices & networks (96 batch, 6 parallel streams).
proxy_subtitle: Configure SOCKS5/HTTP/MTProto routing, timeout & aggressive retry adjustments for slow networks/VPNs.
debug_subtitle: Full AutoGram & Telegram Drive log buffer
debug_desc: Captures worker + UI logs to debug repeating downloads, fallbacks, and transfer errors. Slightly slower when active. Do not share logs — they may contain file paths & names.
debug_empty_buffer: Empty buffer — run a download, upload, or open Media Studio to populate logs.
debug_tip: Jobs already running (drive-serve / downloads) need to be restarted after toggle for flags to take full effect.
backend_native_desc: Grammers is the active MTProto backend for Accounts, Sessions, media list, document preview, progressive video chunking, and seeking.
confirm_clear_cache_msg: Are you sure you want to clear all cache? All thumbnails, media previews, and local folder history will be cleaned.
confirm_clear_db_msg: Are you sure you want to clear the local database? All job history and local sessions will be wiped.
creds_save_success: ✓ Credentials saved to Rust Keychain successfully!
network_saved_reconnect: Network settings saved. Reconnect the Drive session to apply the proxy configuration.
backend_ownership_desc: Accounts, session switching, document previews, and progressive video are locked to Grammers + Rust so there is one connection source and one session owner.
proxy_unreachable_hint: Hint: Telegram DC is slow or unreachable — consider enabling VPN Optimizer or Proxy.
cache_clear_success: ✓ Cache cleared successfully! Navigation will reload from scratch.
cache_clear_error: Failed to clear the disk cache.
database_clear_success: ✓ Transfer database cleared successfully! Transfer history is now clean.
database_clear_error: Failed to clear the transfer database. Check the console logs for details.
